text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder and I stop by the<n>shopping district
on our way home.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Here it is. My favorite flower shop.
choice_data_list: Are you going to buy something?
Are you going to buy something?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Just a few flowers. The empty vase<n>in the dorm
lobby is such a forlorn<n>sight.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
What's a flower vase without<n>flowers? I figured I
could pick a few<n>to brighten things up.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Don't you think seeing them every<n>day would help
to brighten<n>everyone's spirits?
choice_data_list: I think that's a great idea.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I've been very passionate about<n>flower
arrangement, ever since I was<n>little.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
It feels wonderful that I get to<n>continue my hobby
here too.
choice_data_list: I'd love to see it once you're finished.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes, certainly. I'd like to share my<n>interests with
you, after all.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I know! Since you're here, why don't<n>you try
arranging a vase too?
choice_data_list: Do you think I can pull it off?
Let's choose some to decorate my office.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Of course. Like other traditional arts,<n>flower
arrangement is as much a<n>philosophy as a skill.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The essence of such arts lies in the<n>will to stay true
to one's own chosen<n>path.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
As long as you keep moving forward,<n>you will
surely reach the goal you<n>seek. That is the beauty
of these<n>traditions.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. To tell you the truth, it's not all<n>that different
from racing.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
That's how I know you'll do just<n>fine, Trainer.
Let's make something<n>beautiful together. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Encouraged by Grass Wonder's<n>words, I work
with her to pick out a<n>selection of flowers.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
That's a lovely idea. Flowers are a<n>wonderful
addition to anyone's daily<n>life.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
And with different blooms staggered<n>throughout the
year, bouquets are an<n>excellent way to enjoy the
ever-changing seasons.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
You spend a fair amount of time in<n>that office, so
we had best put a lot of<n>thought into which flowers
to use.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I almost forgot about the vase in<n>my dorm's
lobby. Hehehe. There's<n>so much to think about. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder is practically walking<n>on air as we
pick out flowers<n>together.
